lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Tracing shadows on the dashboard light
Chasing whispers through the hollow night
The city hums a low-key prayer
Finding pieces of the truth hidden there
[Pre-Chorus]
Counting breaths in the heavy air
Finding grace in the silence they share
[Chorus]
Fading slowly like a dying spark
Moving softly through the velvet dark
Weightless souls in a restless frame
Changing colors but staying the same
[Verse]
Neon signs paint the pavement gold
Stories written but left untold
Coffee turns cold in a ceramic cup
Looking down, then slowly looking up
[Pre-Chorus]
Counting breaths in the heavy air
Finding grace in the silence they share
[Chorus]
Fading slowly like a dying spark
Moving softly through the velvet dark
Weightless souls in a restless frame
Changing colors but staying the same
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
Dust of stars in the cosmic deep
Secrets that the ancient galaxies keep
[Chorus]
Fading slowly like a dying spark
Moving softly through the velvet dark
Weightless souls in a restless frame
Changing colors but staying the same
[Outro]
